title: Father's encouragement, aunt's organ and a work ethic
summary: His father helped him; his mother's sister on organ brought people around; he learned to work from his father.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, did your dad encourage you to play the cornet, or did he just kind of not want you to be a musician?
Yeah, he tried to help me. He tried to help me, you know, and then my aunt come along with the organ

and that's another thing that helped a whole lot. I don't know what she jumped in there for, but she got in there, and I had people all over me. As soon as they found out that I had a cornet.
